c.tagline: Türkiye's modernist capital, from Atatürk's mausoleum to an ancient hilltop citadel.

taxi.fareNote: Yellow taxis are metered; Uber and BiTaksi dispatch licensed cabs. Make sure the meter (taksimetre) is running and keep small cash on hand.

emergency.note: 112 is the unified nationwide emergency number connecting to police, ambulance, and fire across Türkiye.

avoid.reason: Pickpocketing around Ulus/Kızılay; caution at night

hood_desc: The historic core on the citadel hill, home to Ankara Castle (Ankara Kalesi), the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, Roman ruins, and old bazaars; best for first-timers who want the city's oldest sights and traditional atmosphere.
Ankara's bustling downtown around Kızılay Square, where the Metro and Ankaray lines meet; packed with shops, bookstores, cafes, and student life, it's the most central base for getting anywhere fast.

An upscale, leafy district of embassies, ministries, and quiet residential streets rising toward the Presidential Complex; calm and green, it suits travelers wanting a relaxed, well-to-do area away from the crowds.
The dining-and-nightlife spine of the city along Tunalı Hilmi Avenue, lined with restaurants, bars, cafes, and shopping; great for travelers who want to be where Ankara goes out in the evening.
A pleasant middle-class residential neighborhood west of the center, famous for its lively 7. Cadde (7th Street) full of casual eateries and cafes; a comfortable, local-feeling base near Anıtkabir.

water.note: Officially treated and chlorinated, but aging pipes mean bottled water is the safer choice for visitors.

transit.hours: Metro and Ankaray run roughly 06:00 to midnight; EGO city buses cover the evening with limited late-night service.
transit.note: Ankara's rail network combines the Ankaray light-metro line and the M1-M4 Metro lines, all feeding the central Kızılay interchange, backed by an extensive EGO bus network.
transit.pay: A rechargeable Ankarakart smart card is tapped on entry across the Metro, Ankaray, and buses; fares are loaded to the card and there is no on-board cash payment.

bus: Ankara Intercity Bus Terminal (AŞTİ) for coaches nationwide
train: High-speed rail (YHT) to Istanbul, Konya, Eskişehir, and Sivas from Ankara Gar

transit.m: Belko Air / HAVAŞ shuttle bus to Kızılay city center (~40-50 min)

tip.r: ~5-10% at restaurants for good service; round up taxi fares and leave small change at cafes.
